items.excerpt: Two Salvadoran soldiers died in Haiti after an explosion struck an area where they were working, weeks after President Nayib Bukele ordered a large deployment to the Caribbean island nation to find missing troops.

items.title: Bayer’s $7.25 Billion Roundup Settlement Approved by Judge
items.excerpt: A Missouri judge approved a Bayer AG proposal to contain its mounting legal costs by paying as much as $7.25 billion to resolve tens of thousands of US lawsuits by people who blame the company’s Roundup weedkiller for their cancers.

items.excerpt: The Japanese yen and Swiss franc outperformed their major peers as growing doubts about the sustainability of the artificial intelligence boom drove demand for havens and put pressure on the US dollar.
